lapses.why: R0 caps an API key at 365 days; keys, invites and ABS sessions get the longest life R0 allows, and a replay after answers_valid_until sees expired rows. Web sessions keep R0's fixed 7-day remember-me TTL; no answer reads them

credentials: every credential in this corpus is a generated fixture value (invariant 2); API keys in answer files are <api-key:NAME> placeholders

invites for every seeded role (admin, editor, viewer, fp-worker), accepted (each sets a session)
deactivate one viewer
an invite left open and one revoked
web logins (remember_me) for several users
scoped, empty-scope, every-atom, admin-owned-for-another-user, fp-worker keys
PUT /api/v1/config: plain keys of every class and the four IsSecret secrets
operator layers: gap-fill config.yaml beside the store, env per layer, viper YAML
integration fields and the webhook plugin through PUT /api/v1/config, then a restart
an import root added through the API; its auto-scan imports the fixture library

a library scan run that succeeds
a library scan of a missing folder (fails)

a running library scan stood down by maintenance.metadata-refresh (R0's scans never take the stand-down; maintenance ops do), then a second scan held queued by the stand-down's re-queue grace; the stop leaves both rows as they are
the executor paused through POST /operations/pause and left paused at the stop

not_writable_by_r0_api.why: OAuth identities are created only by an SSO sign-in against an external provider
the invite allow-list is written only when an invite delivered by email is consumed
AI jobs are created only through the OpenAI Batch API (no fake endpoint in R0)

a clean stop cannot leave a run running or stopping: Registry.Shutdown (internal/operations/registry/registry.go at the R0 tag) cancels every running op with ErrShutdown and marks what has not drained interrupted per its ResumePolicy; F2-13 writes these states

overlay.label: corrupt-settings-secret

overlay.label: blob-field-unmapped

overlay.label: role-every-atom

overlay.label: role-subset
overlay.expected: a custom role holding a subset of the atoms: imported as custom.<slug> with the union of its atoms' native scopes plus the ambient scopes

overlay.label: role-unknown-atom

overlay.label: role-all-unknown

overlay.label: corrupt-role
overlay.expected: a role row that does not decode: quarantined (a role is never a blocker); the step completes

overlay.label: corrupt-inviteallow

overlay.label: key-outside-owner

overlay.label: key-every-atom-custom-owner

overlay.label: key-empty-custom-owner
overlay.expected: an empty scope list (HEAD's 'all of the owner's role permissions') under a custom-role owner: imported with the owner's native role set plus the ambient scopes, never empty

overlay.label: status-edge-user-unknown

overlay.label: status-edge-key-upper-inactive

overlay.label: status-edge-key-empty

overlay.label: status-edge-key-padded-revoked

blockers.label: blocker-merge-applying
blockers.expected: a merge journal at applying (HEAD's merge canceled mid-apply): the preflight refuses the boot naming the merge and the fix (finish or undo it on the pre-freeze release), nothing written
